capabilities: Upload pasted and dropped images, video, audio, and PDF files to Alibaba Cloud OSS
Insert Markdown embeds at the cursor with configurable object paths and filename strategies
Serve uploads via public URLs, custom-domain/CDN URLs, or temporary signed URLs
Migrate local image embeds in the current note to OSS without deleting files by default
Delete unreferenced OSS objects after retention checks when their last link is removed
disambiguation: Not a generic cloud uploader; it only uploads to Alibaba Cloud OSS, not S3 or other providers.
extras: Manual installation only (download the release zip into .obsidian/plugins/). Remote cleanup is irreversible on OSS and off by default; the README includes security guidance, a network/privacy disclosure, and an FAQ, with additional troubleshooting docs in Chinese.
intentEvidence: Cloud Image Uploader uses a new Alibaba OSS-first implementation and architecture.
problem: Obsidian stores pasted and dropped attachments inside the local vault, which grows the vault and offers no built-in way to host them on Alibaba Cloud OSS.

relations.evidence: The user experience was inspired by S3 Image Uploader, an MIT-licensed Obsidian plugin.
uploads pasted and dropped attachments to Alibaba Cloud OSS and inserts the resulting Markdown embed

requires.name: Alibaba Cloud AccessKey ID and secret (dedicated RAM user or STS credentials)
Alibaba Cloud OSS storage and transfer charges

summary: Uploads pasted and dropped images and attachments to Alibaba Cloud OSS and inserts the resulting Markdown embed at the cursor.
